question: From A030's unchanged 0.85s RT release, can a continuous route achieve useful LB_M protection before ordinary runner arrival?

routes.purpose: Continue around the DL's outboard and upfield shoulder before intercepting LB_M.
Recover behind the keeper and climb his inside shoulder to LB_M.

steering: Continuous fixed-winding tangent plus radial correction around the selected moving body, until a direct first-strike corridor clears both RG and DT. Orbit speed uses sqrt(existing lateral acceleration * 0.8 * existing body-clearance radius); World executes every request. This is a physical diagnostic, not production navigation.
clearance: Existing summed body radii plus0.15yd route radius. Actual initial overlap may open normally; no collision/body/spacing bypass. First-strike corridor checked at now and next native decision, with opening-overlap rule.
information: Privileged instantaneous anchor/keeper/LB geometry sampled at native RT decision cadence and dead-reckoned between reads. Existing native LB approach receives that oracle picture. Explicit upper-bound information diagnostic: no evidence the production observer can select this route. No future RB path is read or frozen.
fixed: All22 native reactions, native release/assignment/force/support/capacity/roster/settings/random initialization. Only RT post-release free movement and its diagnostic LB picture are overridden. Once RT earns contact, native controller/contact take over.
budget: Two predeclared A030 continuations, each max5 native seconds/10wall seconds. No baseline rerun, new cases, rosters or games. Only if a route produces actual protection, one acquired-information comparison may isolate why production misses it. If neither works, stop route trials and inspect upstream saved opening/release evidence.
judgment: Actual arrival shoulder, native LB block/contact load, defender route through actual runner arrival, first carrier contact, runner progress/speed and traffic/first-level costs. Nearest distance or final yardage alone cannot pass.
opposingEvidence: Reuse unchanged accepted A027 useful collection/defensive recovery; no production candidate is proposed by a successful oracle action. All real obstructing bodies and native spacing stay active in the failure itself.
